title: Software Engineer I
subtitle: Avaya · Pune
details: Workflow trigger so embedded screens start workflows through the trusted agent desktop, without receiving workflow credentials.
Workflow API catalog of approved internal APIs, with OpenAPI contracts, request validation, and list and by-ID endpoints.
Public API rate limiting in the service mesh. Transcript traffic is capped at 6,000 requests per minute.
Notification service on Azure AKS: dependency-aware health checks, resilient rollouts, and three merge-blocking CI quality and security gates.
Admin About page for service and release versions, and account settings that turn agentless campaigns on, with the matching configuration-service change.
Playwright coverage for outbound campaigns: timer lifecycle, exactly-once auto-dial, and duplicate or out-of-order events.
Agentless email and SMS proofs of concept, including Twilio, plus a test runbook.

title: Software Development Intern
subtitle: Avaya · Pune
details: Kafka and Avro event streaming: a Spring Boot app writes real-time events to a topic, and a consumer reads them into a readable form.
Python and Ansible automation, and a Spring Boot orchestrator with JPA, to upgrade Avaya Aura components on remote hosts.
A neural-network prototype that ranks agents for an incoming customer query.
